text:
alex: Quick sync — given infra constraints and risk to SLA we should trim a couple items from MVP and shift the milestone +2w. Proposal: drop animated onboarding, deprioritize embeddings prefetch, keep core routing/SLA and telemetry. Thoughts?

maya: +1 to deprioritize embeddings prefetch for MVP. We can surface a clear v1 path for caching. :thumbsup:

devon: Concern — embeddings prefetch helps cold-start for search-heavy flows. If we cut it, can we do a lightweight warming job instead (daily prefix warm) as a stopgap?

sam: We can do a tiny warming job targeted at Dedicated tenants only. Low-ish dev cost and buys latency improvements.

olivia: Animated onboarding is ~80h of design/dev. We can swap for a static hero + improved microcopy and ship the same flows. Designers can deliver static assets by EOD Wed.

alex: OK. Proposed timeline change: move launch window from Apr 8 -> Apr 22 (two-week shift). That gives time for warm job + QA and small rollout rehearsals.

maya: We should tell Sales + CS asap. @jess can you notify pilots and adjust demo commitments?

jess: On it. I'll update pilot customers and push back demo slots. Messaging we should give them: "core generation, smart routing, basic telemetry" (no prefetch or animated onboarding).

devon: Also we need explicit gating criteria for canary. Proposal: `p95 latency < 200ms`, `error rate < 0.1%`, and no regressions on our prompt set. If gate fails, fallback to smaller model variant and roll back traffic.

alex: Agree. I'll add that to the rollout checklist. Add a short rollback playbook item to fallback to model-variant B.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-window Apr 20 07:00 UTC for 24h. Reminder: notify #eng-oncall.

sam: I'll book 3 dev-days to implement the warming job and the light fallback.

olivia: I'll upload the static onboarding assets and inline microcopy notes by EOD today. :eyes:

alex: Decision recap: cut animated onboarding + embeddings prefetch from MVP, implement warming job for Dedicated customers, move launch +2w, canary gating as `p95 < 200ms` and `error < 0.1%`, rollback -> smaller variant. I'll post a follow-up doc in the product wiki and open a release-checklist PR.

jess: Thanks — I'll coordinate customer comms and update pilot decks.

alex: Thanks all. Small follow-ups: sam will add warming job ticket, devon will update gating tests, olivia will hand off assets. We'll reconvene Wed morning for final readout.
